title: Athena by Shoplazza
claim: Product Hunt: Athena by Shoplazza — An orchestrator agent for your entire commerce stack
why_good: Athena's ability to integrate and optimize multiple e-commerce tools could streamline operations for businesses, making it indispensable.
value: E-commerce platforms and retailers would pay for subscription services or transaction fees based on sales volume facilitated through the orchestrator.
risk: If larger e-commerce platforms decide to build similar orchestration features in-house, Athena could struggle to compete.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
